column18: Overview of neuromorphic circuit design (encoders, delay-feedback reservoir, hybrid NNs); DFR claimed more efficient than RNN, no figures
Adaptive-threshold recurrent LIF layer claims low power from far fewer weights than SimpleRNN, GRU, LSTM; no figures
Compiler framework (SODA, MLIR dialect) for generating digital and spiking accelerators; design discussion, no efficiency comparison
BN scaling-factor and effective-weight magnitude pruning for robust sparse models; verifies LTH; no efficiency figures
SNN wavefront benchmark on CPU (NEST), SpiNNaker, GPU (GeNN): simulation time, energy per run, path length; no figures
Simulator benchmark (NEST, Brian2, Brian2GeNN, BindsNET, Nengo): speed and scalability; NEST 2x or more speedup in some workloads
Functional lottery ticket hypothesis for OOD generalization; Modular Risk Minimization selects subnetworks; no efficiency metric
CELL: up to 3.6% higher accuracy with 4.3x smaller communication cost on CIFAR-10 (simulation); no energy metric
Analytic comparison under identical silicon: most rate-coded SNN implementations not more energy or resource efficient than the source ANN
CSSAC sparse storage compression for LSM: 14-55% less on-chip storage, 5-46% less power on MNIST, NMNIST, DVS Gesture
Connection pruning cuts connectivity 92.83%; learning 2.1x faster, 64% less energy; inference 2.83x faster, 78.24% less energy; FPGA
LTH pruning of fully connected net explored; VGG-13 best with validation AUROC 82.23%, test 78.3%; no efficiency figures
Lottery tickets found in GANs from small data, then sparse subnetwork trained; gains add to augmentation; no efficiency metrics
CNN-to-SNN conversion with binary weights; less memory than high-precision SNN, accuracy comparable to SNNs; no ANN efficiency comparison
Analysis of winning tickets under SGD stochasticity: structural and functional divergence; no efficiency metrics
Robust subnetworks found in random-init networks without training, matching adversarially trained robust accuracy; claimed efficient; no figures
Hybrid CNN-SNN tomato disease classifier, 97.78% on original images; energy efficiency asserted from event-driven SNN, not measured
Structured early-bird winning tickets in BERT; comparable GLUE and SQuAD performance with 35-45% less training time
Spiking RNNs theoretically 2 to 3 orders of magnitude more energy-efficient than comparable classical ANNs; speech and ECG tasks
ProbMask learns global sparsity masks; up to 10% top-1 gain over prior pruning; also finds supermasks; no efficiency metrics
Winning tickets found on PrAC subset (35-78% of data), saving 63-93% of training iterations on CIFAR and Tiny ImageNet
Resonate-and-fire neurons: optical flow over 90x fewer operations than DNN solution; STFT 47x less output bandwidth, similar complexity
Neuron unrolling for crossbar mapping on DYNAP-SE: 60% fewer crossbars, 62% less wasted energy; avoids pruning; SNN-only
Hybrid ANN-SNN mapping on Tianjic; claims low latency and power, no figures or ANN-vs-SNN efficiency comparison
SNN converted from CNN, <1% accuracy drop; average power 0.077 W, 0.0074x that of previous NN solutions
